title: ConfigFile
description: Top-level `aristo.toml` document. Every field defaults; an empty file produces a `ConfigFile` with each section at its default.

Aggressiveness.description: Nudge aggressiveness ladder. Maps to a numeric factor `f` the scorer multiplies into each signal's normalized pressure: a signal fires when `pressure * f >= 1`, so higher `f` fires sooner. `Off` yields `f = 0`, the structural global opt-out (nothing can fire).

oneOf.description: Quietest: only large backlogs / strong signals surface.
Eager: surfaces sooner and re-arms faster.
Opt-in cross-machine cache via the Aristo server.

CanonConfig.description:
§13 canon-and-matching tunables (Pro/Enterprise tiers only — the free tier ignores this section and surfaces an upgrade nudge).

`enabled` is the project-level opt-out: regulated buyers and air-gapped CI set `enabled = false` to skip canon API calls unconditionally. Default is `true`; tier-gating is server-side (the API returns the upgrade nudge for free-tier tokens).

The two threshold knobs control which match candidates surface. Server enforces a floor of `0.5` (HTTP 400 below that). Defaults match `docs/mockups/13-canon-and-matching/README.md` §L3: - `threshold_stamp = 0.85` — stamp surfaces only high-confidence matches (the daily-loop default; minimizes noise). - `threshold_critique = 0.65` — critique surfaces broader candidates (the deliberate review pass; user is reviewing).

No `flavor` field: scope membership is server-resolved from repo identity per canon-strategy.md §CS8.

enabled.description: Project-level opt-out. Default `true`. When `false`, canon API calls are skipped unconditionally; cached matches remain readable but no new matches are surfaced and no accept-path runs.

threshold_critique.description: Confidence threshold for matches surfaced by `aristo critique`. Honored above the server-enforced `0.5` floor. Default `0.65`.

threshold_stamp.description: Confidence threshold for matches surfaced by `aristo stamp`. Honored above the server-enforced `0.5` floor. Default `0.85`.

contribute.description: Opt-in for paid users to contribute abstracted annotation patterns to the server-side property-template library. Default `false`. Default-on for design partners (set in their contract, applied as user-visible `true`).

commit_artifacts.description: Whether `.aristo/doc/*` markdown + graph artifacts are committed. Default `true` so a fresh clone renders correct docs without re-running anything.

position.description: Where the Aristo-injected `#[doc = ...]` block sits relative to the user's hand-written `///` comments. Default `Before` (verified-intent claims at the top of each item's rendered docs).

oneOf.description: Install a `.git/hooks/pre-commit` script that runs `aristo stamp` and (per `[lint] pre_commit`) `aristo lint`.
Don't install any git hooks. CI is expected to gate via `aristo stamp --check` / `aristo lint --check`.

IndexConfig.description: Filters applied during the source walk. Always-skipped directory names (`target/`, `.git/`, `.aristo/`, `node_modules/`) are hardcoded in the walker; `exclude` adds project-specific globs on top of that floor (e.g., `"**/tests/ui/**"` to skip trybuild fixtures that contain intentional empty-text annotations).

exclude.description: Glob patterns (matched against paths relative to the workspace root) that the walker skips. Standard `**` / `*` / `?` syntax per `globset`. Paths use forward slashes regardless of host OS.

InstanceConfig.description:
`[instance]` — pins this project's **data-plane** requests (verify session dispatch + canon match) to a specific Aretta deployment, e.g. a per-repo conductor at `https://<slug>.aretta.ai`. Absent → data-plane requests fall back to the signed-in account server (default `https://code.aretta.ai`). `ARETTA_API_URL` (env) overrides this for CI / tests.

Distinct from the auth/control-plane server the `arta_*` token is minted against (persisted in the credentials file): the token authenticates the request; `url` decides where verified-data requests are sent.

url.description: Base URL of the per-repo Aretta instance (e.g. `https://turso.aretta.ai`). Normalized like the `--server` flag: a bare host gets `https://`, a trailing `/` is stripped.

pre_commit.description: Pre-commit-hook lint mode. Per J6: string enum (`"off"` / `"check"` / `"fix"`) with bool back-compat (`true` → `Check`, `false` → `Off`).

rules.description: Per-rule configuration overrides. Map key is the rule name (e.g., `"empty_text"`).

strict.description: When `true`, `aristo lint --check` exits non-zero on `warn` findings as well as `error`. Default `false`.

LintPreCommit.description: `[lint] pre_commit` — string enum ("off" | "check" | "fix") or bool (true → "check", false → "off") for J6 back-compat.

LintRuleConfig.description: Per-rule lint configuration. All fields are optional; each individual rule consumes the subset that applies to it (e.g., `pattern` + `message` are only meaningful for the custom-regex rule).

NudgesConfig.description: `[nudges]` — the proactive nudge/progress engine (Phase 18). A single `aggressiveness` knob scales every nudge's fire threshold (and the human-prompt cooldown); `off` silences the engine entirely — the global opt-out, mirroring `[canon] enabled = false`.

aggressiveness.description: How eagerly the engine surfaces nudges. Higher lowers every signal's fire threshold and shortens the human cooldown; `off` disables all nudges. Default `medium`.

hash_crate_root.description: Whether to hash the entire crate token-stream for crate-root annotation staleness detection. Default `false` (expensive on large crates per B3).

hooks.description: Which git hook to install. Default `PreCommit`.

enabled.description: Opt-in toggle for free-tier usage telemetry. Default `false`. Per H8: never gated as required; fully off by default.

commit_specs.description: Whether to commit `.aristo/specs/` to git. Default `true` (matches the .gitignore precedent — fresh clones produce reproducible verification runs).

strategy.description: Where mined-assertion specs are cached. `Local` keeps them in `.aristo/specs/` only; `AristoCloud` opts in to cross-machine caching via the Aristo server (free users must explicitly enable per G7).

default_method.description: Resolves `verify = true` on annotations to a concrete method. `None` means "use the per-tier default" (free → `"test"`, paid → `"full"` per G1).

VerifyMethod.description: Named verification methods (the string form of [`VerifyLevel`]).
